name: Blackfathom Deeps
summary: Blackfathom Deeps is a flooded subterranean temple complex situated along the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. Once a shrine dedicated to the night elven moon goddess Elune, the sunken sanctuary has been overtaken by the Twilight's Hammer cult, treacherous naga, and satyrs. They gather in its dark waters to venerate and nurture Aku'mai, a primordial pet and herald of the Old Gods.

sections.title: Sunken Sanctum of Elune
sections.body: Long before the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor, this complex was a splendid temple dedicated to Elune. Highborne masons raised gem-encrusted bridges while Queen Azshara commanded the surrounding waters, partitionining salt seas and mountain streams around a sacred moonwell. When the Sundering tore the world apart ten thousand years ago, the temple sank into the coastal depths of the Veiled Sea. For millenia, it sat undisturbed beneath the waves—until foul whispers began seeping upward from the subterranean dark.

sections.title: A Den of Ancient Horrors
sections.body: Drawn by mad dreams and dark portents, the Twilight's Hammer cult converged on the sunken ruins. Within, they forged an unholy truce with coastal naga led by Lady Sarevess and prowling satyrs. Together, they desecrated the moonwell and enslaved local life. They drove the giant sea turtle Ghamoo-ra mad through years of torment, allowed the brutal murloc Gelihast to erect a blood shrine, and stocked cavernous depths with fresh sacrifices. Under the leadership of Twilight Lord Kelris, the cultists turned the ruins into a staging ground for the Old Gods' impending return.

sections.title: The Slumbering Herald
sections.body: At the deepest heart of the sunken temple lies Aku'mai, an ancient three-headed hydra carrying a spark of the Old Gods' primordial power. Twilight Lord Kelris believes this devourer is the herald of his dark masters and his personal ticket to immortality. Rather than a wild beast, the cult treats Aku'mai as a cherished divine pet, feeding her subjects and captives to nurture her strength. Striking down Kelris and extinguishing the cult's foul braziers breaks the wards binding her lair, allowing champions to slay the beast before its insatiable hunger is unleashed across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What was Blackfathom Deeps before it fell into darkness?
faq.answer: Originally, it was a magnificent night elven temple dedicated to the moon goddess Elune. It featured crystal-clear pools, gemmed bridges, and a blessed moonwell, all overseen by Queen Azshara before the Great Sundering broke the temple and cast it beneath the sea.

faq.q: Why are the Twilight's Hammer cultists here?
faq.answer: Drawn by nightmare visions and whispering voices from beneath Azeroth, the cultists came to worship the Old Gods. Under Twilight Lord Kelris, they took over the sunken ruins to nurture Aku'mai, offering living sacrifices in hopes of hastening the return of their chaotic masters.

Twilight Lord Kelris is the leader of the Twilight's Hammer cell within Blackfathom Deeps. Convinced that the awakening of Aku'mai will grant him eternal life and bring about the reign of the Old Gods, he orchestrates the cult's sacrifices and oversees the desecration of the temple.

faq.q: What are the naga and satyr doing in the ruins?
faq.answer: Both the naga and satyrs were lured to the drowned temple by lingering ancient magical energies. The naga, led by Lady Sarevess, formed a pact with the Twilight's Hammer: the cultists feed her captives and dark knowledge, and in return, her sea witches provide magical shielding against the horrors lurking in the deep.

faq.q: Why do the Earthen Ring and Argent Dawn care about this place?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn sent Scout Thaelrid to investigate suspicious alliances between the naga and cultists, uncovering proof of their murderous rituals. Meanwhile, the Earthen Ring rushed to Ashenvale because the invocation of Old Gods threatens the elemental balance and safety of the entire world.

faq.q: What happens when Aku'mai is defeated?
aliases: what happens when you kill aku'mai
faq.answer: Slaying Aku'mai severs the immediate physical foothold of the Old Gods within Ashenvale. It thwarts Twilight Lord Kelris's plot to unleash an ancient, flesh-devouring herald upon Kalimdor, striking a major blow against the Twilight's Hammer cult and cleansing a fragment of the dark taint infecting the ruined moonwell.

angles.text: For night elves, the deeps represent a heartbreaking desecration of their heritage, as an ancient shrine of Elune and its sacred moonwell have been befouled by void cultists and monstrous aberrations.
Shaman answering the call of Je'neu and the Earthen Ring must plunge into the watery dark to halt the corruption of the elements and banish the chaotic taint of the Old Gods.

Operating out of Zoram'gar Outpost, the Horde seeks to secure the northern coast of Ashenvale from encroaching naga aggression and prevent the dark rituals within the deeps from threatening their outposts.
Alliance heroes enter to rescue Scout Thaelrid, recover lost Highborne knowledge, and aid the night elves in cleansing their sacred homeland from cultist terror.
